name: Lady Vashj
guide_text: This hero provides free early game tempo. Don’t have to play into Nagas that hard.
buddy_guide_text: Buddy up first when it costs 0-2, and enjoy some free spellcrafts while playing the game normally. Buddy up second when it costs 3-5. This buddy enables spell casting nagas but don't force it.
